Definition: from G1722 and G4198; to travel in (a country as a pedlar), i.e. (by implication) to trade:--buy and sell, make merchandise.
BiblicalUsage: The word of the travelling trader — to buy and sell, to make merchandise. James warns those who plan to go to a city and buy and sell and get gain in James 4:13, and Peter says false teachers will make merchandise of you through covetousness in 2 Peter 2:3.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the warning is about what we do with people — trading in them for gain — and I want my plans held loosely, because my life is a vapour, not a business venture.
RelatedPeople: James, Brother of Jesus; Simon Peter
